claims.text: AIOS treats the LLM as a kernel-managed resource, with the operating-system kernel providing a scheduler, a context manager, a memory manager, a storage manager and access control.
AIOS's context manager snapshots and restores the state of LLM generation, which enables context switching between agents' requests.
Letta sleep-time agents, introduced in Letta 0.7.0 in April 2025, asynchronously edit in-context memory blocks while the primary agent is serving the user.
Anthropic's post on components of agent memory credits the sleep-time compute idea from Letta and UC Berkeley as the source for its 'dreaming' consolidation.
